vehicle_subTitle: Open Multi-body Simulation Library for Vehicle and Subsystem Analysis
vehicle_introduction: The Vehicle Dynamics Library provides an open and user-extensible simulation environment for the analysis of complete vehicles and their subsystems. Based on a hierarchical structure and an extensive library of pre-defined vehicle components, it is designed to easily configure various types of vehicles, including passenger cars, trucks, motorsports vehicles, and heavy equipment.

This library supports optimization and verification from the initial design stage of vehicle systems through to control design and implementation. In particular, it enables multi-body and multi-domain simulations with real-time performance and provides the ability to export models for sharing and utilization across various departments within an organization.

feat-0.title: Intuitive Model Configuration for Diverse Vehicle Architectures
feat-0.text: The Vehicle Dynamics Library enables intuitive and flexible model configuration for all types of wheeled vehicles, including various suspension structures such as independent and axle suspensions. Leveraging a hierarchical structure and pre-defined component libraries, users can easily perform modeling for a wide range of vehicles, from passenger cars to heavy-duty machinery.

feat-1.title: High-Precision Multi-body Dynamics and Real-time Simulation
feat-1.text: Based on high-precision multi-body models, the library precisely reproduces the dynamic behavior of vehicles while also supporting lightweight model configurations for real-time processing. Additionally, it allows for table-based representation of Kinematics & Compliance (K&C) characteristics, making it ideal for analyzing the kinematic properties and flexibility of suspensions.

feat-2.title: Compatibility with Diverse Tire Models
feat-2.text: The library is compatible not only with TYDEX STI (Standard Tyre Interface)-based models but also with high-precision tire models from the FTire and Delft-Tyre families. This ensures realistic simulation of tire behavior under various road conditions and driving scenarios.

feat-3.title: Support for Integration with Various Parameter File Formats
feat-3.text: Parameter settings can be configured using various data formats—including XML, JSON, MAT, Adams, and CarMaker (*.skc)—facilitating easy integration with existing design data or external simulation environments. This enhances model configuration flexibility and data reusability.

feat-4.title: Support for Custom 3D Road Models and OpenCRG Integration
feat-4.text: In addition to custom 3D road models, the library integrates with high-precision OpenCRG-based road surfaces, enabling driving simulations that closely mirror real-world environments. It is highly effective for constructing test scenarios that reflect complex road geometries and conditions.
